map.生成在红绿/蓝黄色盲、全色盲等 8 种色觉类型下都能清晰区分的配色方案。支持顺序: Generate palettes that stay clearly distinguishable under 8 vision types including red-green/blue-yellow color blindness and achromatopsia. Supports three modes—sequential / diverging / qualitative—and lets you lock key colors so generation expands around them; uses "lightness-alternating / maximize-luminance-difference" strategies to stay separable under CVD; previews all 8 simulations side by side in real time on canvas, validates via WCAG 2.1 contrast, and one-click copies HEX / CSS variables / JSON.
map.所有候选色在 OKLCH 感知均匀空间采样，逐一做 8 型色觉变换（Machad: All candidate colors are sampled in the perceptually uniform OKLCH space, transformed through the 8 vision types (Machado matrix for red/green blindness, grayscale desaturation for achromatopsia) then converted to CIE Lab; a greedy algorithm picks the set that maximizes the pairwise minimum ΔE across all 8 types. Core strategy: color-vision deficiency mainly compresses hue differences while luminance (L*) differences are largely preserved—so sequential palettes follow a single-hue lightness gradient, qualitative palettes alternate light/dark, and diverging palettes put the center brightest and the ends darkest, all staying distinguishable under CVD. WCAG contrast = (Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05).

Even if a palette has sufficient ΔE under the 8 types, real color-blind users may still be affected by monitor, ambient light, and individual differences; for safety-critical information (e.g. traffic, medical charts) do not rely on color alone—always add shapes, textures, or text labels. The model uses linear severity interpolation, deviating from real spectral responses.

map.教学/科研作图：避免红绿配对，改用蓝橙或加纹理与标注。: Teaching/research plots: avoid red-green pairing; use blue-orange or add texture and labels.
map.在 OKLCH 采样 6 色，逐对做 8 型色觉变换（红/绿用 Machado: Sample 6 colors in OKLCH, apply the 8 vision-type transforms pair by pair (Machado matrix for red/green, desaturation for achromatopsia) then compare; if a pair's post-transform perceived distance is too small, drop one and resample, so the final 6 colors exceed the threshold for minimum perceived distance under every CVD type.
map.OKLCH 在感知上近似均匀，按它采样与比较距离更贴近「人眼觉得差多少」，避免: OKLCH is perceptually near-uniform, so sampling and distance comparison better match "how different the eye perceives", avoiding the issue where RGB/HSL equal steps look unequal.
map.不是。安全是指「在色觉缺陷下仍可区分」，仍可在 OKLCH 内按明度/色相约束挑: No. "Safe" means "still distinguishable under CVD"; you can still pick attractive, high-contrast combinations within OKLCH under lightness/hue constraints.
map.关键区分建议「颜色+形状/纹理/标注」多重编码，单靠配色在重度缺陷下仍可能吃力，: For critical distinctions, use "color + shape/texture/label" multi-encoding; color alone may still struggle under severe deficiency—multi-encoding is safer.
map.检查配色在 8 种色觉类型与灰度下的两两 ΔE 可辨识度，输出混淆预警、灰度明度: Check the pairwise ΔE distinguishability of a palette under the 8 vision types and grayscale, outputting confusion warnings, grayscale lightness-ladder scoring, and one-click fix
